meta.tagline: Wood-fired sourdough, baked before Larnaca wakes up.
meta.seoTitle: Oak & Ember Bakery · Sourdough & Pastries in Larnaca
meta.seoDescription: Family bakery in Larnaca baking naturally leavened sourdough, croissants and Cypriot classics in a wood-fired oven every morning. Open from 7am.
meta.mapQuery: Oak & Ember Bakery, Zinonos Kitieos 14, Larnaca

sections.headline: Bread the way your grandmother remembers it.
sections.subheadline: Slow-fermented sourdough, flaky butter croissants and warm koulouri, pulled from our wood-fired oven every morning at seven.

sections.heading: Fresh every morning
sections.intro: Everything is mixed by hand, fermented overnight and baked in small batches. When it's gone, it's gone.

items.title: Country sourdough
items.description: Our signature loaf. 36-hour ferment, blistered crust, open crumb.

items.title: Butter croissants
items.description: Laminated with Cypriot butter and baked until deeply golden.

items.title: Village koulouri
items.description: Sesame rings the traditional way, perfect with halloumi.

items.title: Cakes to order
items.description: Olive oil cakes, carrot cake and birthday cakes made to your brief.

sections.heading: Two ovens, one family, a lot of flour.
paragraphs: Andreas learned to bake in his father's village bakery in Lefkara. In 2016 he and Maria opened Oak & Ember with a single wood-fired oven and a stubborn belief that bread should take time.
Today we bake around 300 loaves a day, mill part of our own flour and still start the fire at four in the morning.

sections.heading: Why people cross town for it

items.title: Real fermentation
items.description: No commercial yeast, no shortcuts. Just flour, water, salt and time.

items.title: Wood-fired
items.description: Oak and olive wood give our crusts their smoky depth.

items.title: Local grain
items.description: We work with two farms in the Mesaoria plain for our wheat.

items.title: Made to be shared
items.description: Big loaves, generous slices, and always a taste at the counter.

items.quote: The best sourdough on the island. I drive from Nicosia on Saturdays just for the country loaf.
items.author: Elena P.

items.quote: Their croissants are dangerous. Buy two, you will not regret it.
items.author: Marcus T.

items.quote: Ordered a birthday cake with two days notice and it was perfect. Kind, honest people.
items.author: Sophia K.

sections.heading: Come early, the good stuff goes fast.
sections.intro: Send us a message to pre-order loaves or cakes. We reply the same day.

footer.text: A family bakery on Zinonos Kitieos, Larnaca. Sourdough, pastries and Cypriot classics from a wood-fired oven.
